findings.title: Create path that sends viewLimit has no test
findings.failure_scenario: If someone deletes `viewLimit,` at useMemoShareQueries.ts:41, or makes MemoSharePanel.tsx:127 always send undefined, both tests in memo-share-panel-view-count.test.tsx still pass, because they only call formatViewCount. A user who picks '1 view' would then get an unlimited link, and no test would catch it. The code is correct today.
findings.evidence: web/tests/memo-share-panel-view-count.test.tsx:13-23 has only two cases, and both call formatViewCount(share, t). Neither imports or runs useCreateMemoShare (useMemoShareQueries.ts:35-50, with `viewLimit,` at line 41) or handleCreate (MemoSharePanel.tsx:122-132, with `viewLimit: viewLimit === "none" ? undefined : Number(viewLimit)` at line 127). PLAN.md Scope lists both the create path and the select.
findings.fix: Add a test that mocks memoServiceClient.createMemoShare and calls useCreateMemoShare with viewLimit 10 and with none. Assert that the request's memoShare.viewLimit is 10 and undefined respectively.
findings.verification_note: I read the worktree test file. Its only cases are the two formatViewCount assertions, at lines 14-17 and 19-22. Nothing in it reaches useCreateMemoShare or handleCreate, so removing the viewLimit pass-through at hook line 41 or panel line 127 would leave every test passing. The test-gap claim holds. The current code is correct: the hook passes viewLimit into create(MemoShareSchema), and the panel maps 'none' to undefined and other choices to Number. So this is a coverage gap with no wrong outcome today, which makes no-harm-yet (minor) the right rule. The plan's Acceptance only asked for the formatViewCount test, but its Scope includes the create path. The finding names 'P9' without giving it as a rule id, and I didn't need it to verify a defect-kind finding.

notes:
Exported `formatViewCount(share: MemoShare, t)` from MemoSharePanel.tsx. It uses `memo.share.views-of-limit` ("{{count}} of {{limit}} views") when `viewLimit` is set, otherwise `memo.share.views` ("{{count}} views"). `useCreateMemoShare` mutate variables are now `{ memoName, expireTime?, viewLimit? }`. The panel has a view-limit Select with none/1/10/100, and en.json has the six new keys. Both new vitest tests pass and lint is clean. The slice gate reports `area.build-only` for web, so the prove run happens at the merge gate, not here.
